ActorTalk: Sigh... where am I supposed to find someone to help with testing at this hour...?
I need someone who's not from the engineering department, and they have to be absolutely trustworthy on top of that...
Hey, if it isn't the Gray Raven Commandant! I was there during your speech earlier!
You were absolutely captivating! I thought I couldn't even stand the thought of these kinds of formal occasions, but the moment you started speaking... Oh shoot, it's already this late?
I completely forgot I had something to take care of, haha!

The Spear of F.O.S. system is undergoing routine security checks, and I'm the engineer in charge. But you see, with F.O.S. having just gone through such a major incident, we're short-staffed everywhere.

My anomaly detection model is all set up. Now I just need an outside personnel to help perform a penetration test and retrieve the generated data files. But I can't just ask anyone—the tester has to be absolutely trustworthy.
That's exactly why I'm at my wit's end! Where am I supposed to find... Wait a minute, Gray Raven Commandant, could you help me out?
This is getting a bit annoying.
Sure thing. What do you need me to do?

Please don't say that! There's no one more suitable than the Gray Raven Commandant! If you aren't willing to help, then I'll have to keep looking around. At this rate, I'll never get off work... Please! I'll compensate you for this!
Alright. What do you need me to do?
Thank you so much! Please go to the main computer and log in to the system interface. The system will see this as an attack and record it. All you need to do is give me the exported log data.
Ah, right, didn't you lose your authentication credentials before, Commandant? This works perfectly then—you can re-enter them over there while you're at it.

The main computer is in the terminal control room of the academic building, right next to the training room. I've already sent you the specific coordinates. Thank you again, Commandant! I'll go apply for the budget for your compensation right away!
